A made-up product. Data shown is sample data.

SELECT region, SUM(amount)/1000 AS revenue
FROM orders
WHERE created_at >= '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY revenue DESC;
North America brings in 35% of revenue, but Asia Pacific grew fastest (+22%).

SELECT date_trunc('month', created_at) AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS signups
FROM users
WHERE created_at >= '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
Sign-ups more than doubled this year. March and September launches caused the biggest jumps.

SELECT product, SUM(amount)/1000 AS sales
FROM order_items
GROUP BY product
ORDER BY sales DESC
LIMIT 5;
The Pro plan sells best. Add-ons are 18% of sales — a good place to grow.

SELECT plan,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(cancelled) / COUNT(*), 1) AS churn
FROM subscriptions
GROUP BY plan;
Starter customers leave 10× more often than Enterprise. Consider a nudge to upgrade in month two.

SELECT EXTRACT(month FROM created_at) AS m,
  SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE year = 2025) AS y2025,
  SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE year = 2026) AS y2026
FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
2026 is ahead of 2025 every single month, and 31% ahead overall.
Search brings almost half of all visits. Email is small but converts 3× better.
